```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(ggplot2)
library(admixtools)
library(tidypopgen)
library(knitr)
```

```{r set-directories}
res_dir <- "../results/s06_f_stats/"
```

# Load and group gt

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- gt_load("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_clean_ld.gt")
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% group_by(population)
```

# Loci and sample count

```{r}
nrow(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
count_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
```


# Create f2 blocks directory

```{r}
if (dir.exists("../data/intermediate/f2")) {
  f2_dir <- "../data/intermediate/f2"
} else {
  dir.create("../data/intermediate/f2")
  gt_extract_f2(mad_bor_g1000_sum, outdir = "../data/intermediate/f2")
}
```

# Read in precomputed f2's

```{r}
f2_blocks <- f2_from_precomp(f2_dir)
dim(f2_blocks)
count_snps(f2_blocks)
```

#Test for admixture: F3(Malagasy; Asian, African)


```{r}
malagasy <- c("Betsimisaraka", "Merina", "Diego", "Sakalava_Tsimihety", "Betsileo", "Temoro", "Vezo", "Mikea")
asian <- c("Borneo", "Sumba", "Timor", "KHV", "CHS") # removing ,"BEB","PJL"
african <- c("YRI", "LWK", "GWD", "ESN", "MSL") # Yoruba, Luhya, Gambian, Esan, Mende

test <- qp3pop(f2_blocks, malagasy, asian, african) # A, B ; C

colnames(test) <- c("Malagasy", "Asian", "African", "est", "se", "z", "p")

test$Asian <- sub("BOR", "Borneo", test$Asian)
test$Asian <- sub("CHS", "Han, China", test$Asian)
test$Asian <- sub("KHV", "Kinh, Vietnam", test$Asian)
test$Asian <- sub("PJL", "Punjabi, Pakistan", test$Asian)
test$Asian <- sub("BEB", "Bengali, Bengal", test$Asian)

test$African <- sub("ESN", "Esan, Nigeria", test$African)
test$African <- sub("YRI", "Yoruba, Nigeria", test$African)
test$African <- sub("GWD", "Mandinka, The Gambia", test$African)
test$African <- sub("LWK", "Luhye, Kenya", test$African)
test$African <- sub("MSL", "Mende, Sierra Leone", test$African)

test$Malagasy <- sapply(strsplit(test$Malagasy, "_"), function(x) paste(x, collapse = " "))

print(test)
```

```{r}
obj <- test %>%

obj

```


# F3 values grouped descending all combinations

```{r}
test_grouped <- test %>%
  select(est, se, z, Malagasy, Asian, African) %>%
  reframe(est = est, se = se, z, Malagasy, Asian, African)

test_grouped$highlight <- "NA"
test_grouped$highlight[test_grouped$Asian == "Borneo"] <- "Borneo"
test_grouped$highlight[test_grouped$African == "Esan, Nigeria"] <- "Esan, Nigeria"
# find which rows in test_grouped has $African == "Esan, Nigeria" and $Asian == "Borneo"
test_grouped$highlight[which(test_grouped$African == "Esan, Nigeria" & test_grouped$Asian == "Borneo")] <- "Borneo and Esan, Nigeria"
test_grouped$highlight <- as.factor(test_grouped$highlight)

test_grouped %>%
  group_by(Malagasy) %>%
  arrange(desc(est)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = est, y = reorder(Malagasy, est), color = highlight, shape = highlight, )) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "F3 (Malagasy; Asian, African)", x = "f3", y = NULL, color = "'Source' populations", shape = "'Source' populations") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("NA" = 19, "Borneo" = 3, "Esan, Nigeria" = 15, "Borneo and Esan, Nigeria" = 17), breaks = c("Borneo", "Esan, Nigeria", "Borneo and Esan, Nigeria")) +
  # scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,3,7,15,17,19,21,23)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("NA" = "grey", "Borneo" = "lightpink", "Esan, Nigeria" = "lightblue", "Borneo and Esan, Nigeria" = "purple"), breaks = c("Borneo", "Esan, Nigeria", "Borneo and Esan, Nigeria"))

ggsave(filename = paste0(res_dir, "F3_all_combinations.jpg"), width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

```{r}

# find which rows in test_grouped has $African == "Esan, Nigeria" and $Asian == "Borneo"
```

# F3 values descending (with Yoruba)

```{r}
Y <- test %>%
  filter(African == "Yoruba, Nigeria") %>%
  select(est, se, z, Malagasy, Asian)

Y <- Y[order(Y$est), ]
Y$F3 <- paste(Y$Malagasy, " - ", Y$Asian)
Y$F3 <- factor(Y$F3, levels = Y$F3[order(Y$est, decreasing = TRUE)])

ggplot(Y, aes(x = est, y = F3, colour = Asian, xmax = est - (se / 2), xmin = est + (se / 2))) +
  geom_point() +
  # geom_errorbar()+
  labs(title = "F3 (Malagasy; Asian, African)", x = "f3", y = NULL, colour = "Asian population") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))
```

# Outgroup f3's

An f3 to assess the closest outgroup from a list of alternatives for an admixed population does not make sense, because there is not an equal branch length to the common ancestor. However, replication of Brucato et al 2016 may still be useful to check our data.

Here, we will use F3(Asian, Malagasy; African) as in Brucato et al 2016 to investigate the closest Asian population.

```{r}
african <- c("YRI")

test2 <- qp3pop(f2_blocks, african, asian, malagasy)
colnames(test2) <- c("African", "Asian", "Malagasy", "est", "se", "z", "p")


test2$Asian <- sub("BOR", "Borneo", test2$Asian)
test2$Asian <- sub("CHS", "Han Chinese", test2$Asian)
test2$Asian <- sub("KHV", "Kinh Vietnamese", test2$Asian)
test2$Asian <- sub("PJL", "Punjabi", test2$Asian)
test2$Asian <- sub("BEB", "Bengali", test2$Asian)
test2$Malagasy <- sapply(strsplit(test2$Malagasy, "_"), function(x) paste(x, collapse = " "))

print(test2)
```

```{r}
test2 %>%
  group_by(Malagasy) %>%
  slice(which.max(est))
```

```{r}
Y <- test2 %>%
  filter(African == "YRI") %>%
  select(est, se, Malagasy, Asian) %>%
  reframe(est = est, se = se, Malagasy, Asian)

Y <- Y[order(Y$est), ]
Y$F3 <- paste(Y$Malagasy, " - ", Y$Asian)
Y$F3 <- factor(Y$F3, levels = Y$F3[order(Y$est, decreasing = TRUE)])

ggplot(Y, aes(x = est, y = F3, colour = Asian)) +
  geom_point() + # , xmax = est - (se/2), xmin = est + (se/2)
  labs(title = "F3 (Asian, Malagasy; African)", x = "f3", y = NULL, colour = "Asian population") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5))
```

```{r}
Y <- test2 %>%
  filter(African == "YRI") %>%
  select(est, se, Malagasy, Asian) %>%
  reframe(est = est, se = se, Malagasy, Asian)

Y$F3 <- paste(Y$Malagasy, " - ", Y$Asian)
Y <- Y %>%
  arrange(desc(est)) %>%
  select(est, se, Malagasy, Asian, F3) %>%
  group_by(Malagasy) %>%
  mutate(F3 = forcats::fct_inorder(F3))

ggplot(Y, aes(x = est, y = F3, colour = Asian)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "F3 (Asian, Malagasy; African)", x = "f3", y = NULL, colour = "Asian population") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5))
```

F3 to determine the source, and then F4 ratio to determine the proportion of the two 

Supplementary table for all combinaions of F3 (potentially)


remember that the z-score is affected by population size, so interpretation needs to be careful 

# F4 ratio

# Add an  outgroup

```{r}
hgdp <- gt_load("../data/raw/data_input/HGDP_Axiom_allmap.gt")
hgdp_meta <- read.table("../data/raw/data_input/HGDPid_populations.txt", header = TRUE)
hgdp_meta <- hgdp_meta[match(hgdp$id, hgdp_meta$Id), ]
hgdp$population <- hgdp_meta$population

# subset hgdp to $id == "Gorilla" or $population == "French"
hgdp <- hgdp %>% filter(id == "Gorilla" | population == "French")
# for the gorilla sample, label $population gorilla
hgdp$population[hgdp$id == "Gorilla"] <- "Gorilla"
```

```{r}
if (file.exists("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_hgdp.gt")) {
  file.remove("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_hgdp.gt")
  file.remove("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_hgdp.bk")
  file.remove("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_hgdp.rds")
}
```


```{r}
# ungroup
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% ungroup()
mad_bor_g1000_sum_g <- rbind(mad_bor_g1000_sum, hgdp,
  as_is = FALSE, flip_strand = TRUE,
  quiet = FALSE, backingfile = "../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_hgdp"
)


mad_bor_g1000_sum_g <- gt_load("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_hgdp.gt")
```

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum_g <- mad_bor_g1000_sum_g %>% group_by(population)
```

# F4 ratio 

Sister taxon and outgroup on the left, target in the centre, and sister population and source of admixture on the right.

Here, we are estimating the proportion of African admixture. 

```{r}
malagasy <- c("Betsimisaraka", "Merina", "Diego", "Sakalava_Tsimihety", "Betsileo", "Temoro", "Vezo", "Mikea")

pop_matrix <- as.matrix(data.frame("French", "Gorilla", malagasy, "Borneo", "ESN"))

qp4_african_p <- qpf4ratio(f2_blocks, pop_matrix)

qp4_african_p$pop3 <- factor(qp4_african_p$pop3, levels = c("Betsimisaraka", "Merina", "Diego", "Sakalava_Tsimihety", "Betsileo", "Temoro", "Vezo", "Mikea"))
# order by qp4_african_p$pop3 levels
qp4_african_p <- qp4_african_p %>% mutate(pop3 = forcats::fct_inorder(pop3))
# round alpha to 1 decimal place
qp4_african_p
```

```{r}
# FIX LEGEND
qp4_african_p <- qp4_african_p %>%
  arrange(desc(alpha)) %>%
  mutate(pop3 = forcats::fct_inorder(pop3))
ggplot(qp4_african_p, aes(x = alpha, y = pop3, colour = pop3, fill = pop3)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Proportion of African admixture into Malagasy populaitons", x = paste("Admixture proportion \u03b1"), y = NULL, colour = "Malagasy population", fill = "Malagasy population") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5)) +
  guides(colour = "none", fill = "none")
```


Merina is lowest, as expected
